Design scope

What the architecture covers

Organize an estate-scale home without losing clarity. We connect private wings, guest spaces, amenities, staff areas and landscape through one architectural plan.

01Master and family wingCreate quiet private zones with direct access to the spaces used every day.
02Guest accommodationPlan formal rooms and guest suites with their own clear movement.
03AmenitiesIntegrate lounges, cinema, gym, pool or other requested spaces into the structure.
04Staff and service zonesKeep deliveries, kitchens, utilities and staff movement discreet and efficient.
05Landscape and arrivalCoordinate gates, drives, courts, lawns and terraces with the building mass.
06Complete drawing setIssue architecture that specialists and contractors can coordinate and price.

Eight-step process

From brief to buildable drawings

Each stage closes the important decisions before the next one begins.

01

Brief and site analysis

Confirm the project brief, review the site and record the constraints that shape the design.

02

Concept planning

Test layout, zoning, access and movement before the architectural form is fixed.

03

Form and 3D studies

Develop the exterior character and review key views, proportions and materials.

04

Design development

Resolve dimensions, openings, levels, materials and the key technical decisions.

05

Working drawings

Prepare coordinated plans, sections, elevations and the agreed construction details.

06

Authority submission

Develop the required architectural set around the relevant approval process.

07

Specialist coordination

Align structure, MEP, landscape and amenity requirements with the approved architecture.

08

Final handover

Issue the agreed drawing package for pricing, coordination and construction.

Architecture fees

A clear range before the proposal

The fee covers architectural design and drawings. Construction, interior design and fit-out are separate unless they are added to the brief.

IncludedConcept planning, exterior design, design development, working drawings and consultant coordination.
Final feeThe final proposal reflects amenities, basement or multi-storey scope, specialist input and drawing depth.
Separate costsGovernment charges, surveys and third-party specialist fees are confirmed separately where needed.
Indicative design feePKR 1M–2M

The final proposal reflects amenities, basement or multi-storey scope, specialist input and drawing depth.
